title: ModelSemanticMeta
description:
Per-level model content preimage; sorted inventories are derived by the reader.

Excludes level labels, fit/evidence annotations, other levels, legacy aliases,
shard paths and physical packaging. Content identity is not fit provenance,
tokenizer/architecture admission or release qualification. Profile is proposed.

assets.description: Every named asset content digest, sorted by name.

tensors.description: Every named tensor semantic digest in one complete level, sorted by name.

BlobId.description: Content identity for stored tensor or asset bytes.

NamedAssetDigest.description: Exact named asset-content binding in the candidate model preimage.

content.description: Exact stored asset-content digest, not a shard/package identity.

name.description: Asset basename; names affect model semantics.

NamedTensorDigest.description: Named logical tensor binding in the candidate model preimage.

content.description: Logical tensor digest, never its packed blob identity.

SemanticTensorDigest.description: Identity for a tensor's semantic values independent of its container.
